scope: New single-domain native FLS callback ownership composition and its own native integration fixtures; not additional recovered target function bodies

independent_validation.terminal_policy: Own fixture installs a terminate handler that calls TerminateProcess(GetCurrentProcess(),88), with abort fallback, to avoid intentionally invalid dependency lifetime during process FLS rundown. This verifies entry into fatal boundaries, not a general Windows shutdown model.

reviewed_properties: Binding publication occurs after construction of all members; duplicate binding fails without native slot allocation.
Native registered index is distinct from recovered State; FlsFree failure leaves native ownership and callback binding alive despite recovered invalidation; retry releases the retained index.
Repeated initialize cannot overwrite a live native index; retry before recovered uninitialize and invalid release identity are rejected.
WINAPI callback is noexcept, rejects the construction sentinel and catches all C++ exceptions from recovered PTD data destruction before terminating.

Source sentinel allocation reentry, publish-before-construct reentry, source LastError preservation, allocation failure errno bootstrap, explicit free/reacquire and real current-thread FlsFree cleanup are exercised.

Worker fixture uses own joined std::thread; the main thread does not inspect or mutate shared fixture counters, maps, references or success flag between creation and join. Joined worker FLS cleanup is observed before final main-thread inspection.

Borrowed heap, PTD data, identities and error proxy dependencies remain alive throughout all normal callbacks and successful native release; Fixture clears its observation pointer only after normal slots are released.
Existing recovered PTD, PTD-data, CRT glue, heap and errno bodies are reused unchanged; original image addresses are evidence identities, not invoked callback pointers.
limits: Caller uses only Binding's own State, does not overwrite its index, and supplies quiescence before source uninitialize, retry or destruction; no initializer or callback may remain in flight at destruction.

Single active callback domain only. Threaded fixture serializes all shared mutable provider access via launch/join; controlled lock, atomic, locale and global providers do not establish general concurrent CRT semantics.

Arbitrary caller mutation, external native release, unsupported invalid-pointer callbacks, original target execution, complete DLL integration, ABI, SEH/unwind and original-versus-rebuilt runtime equivalence are not established.
